exposure: mode of birth (Cesarean vs. vaginal delivery)
outcome: exclusive breastfeeding during the first six months
cohort: The study included 392 mothers whose children were aged between 2 and 5 years.
finding: Breastfeeding practices in Turkiye are influenced by perceived milk insufficiency, socioeconomic factors, maternal chronic illness, and mode of birth, with extended family involvement uniquely having a negative impact on exclusive breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with increased formula use, while normal spontaneous vaginal delivery increased the odds of exclusive breastfeeding in the first six months.
